original_intent: Do #1364 first, adjust the code if necessary for whatever reasons you deem, then push. The database share is by design.
derived_intent: Preserve intended shared database behavior. Reconcile master and harden the original manual workspace snapshot launcher cleanup, argument parsing, and existing filesystem matching.
active_boundaries: No merge or deployment, no new automatic-run restriction, no expansion of filesystem preflight into other Dactyl routes. Real Docker/Podman execution is unavailable.
repo_scope: src/decapod/core/db.rs; src/decapod/core/workspace.rs; launcher unit tests; living specifications; required generated artifacts

checks.name: Eight focused integration targets with serial test scheduling
cargo test --locked --offline --lib with serial test scheduling

evidence: Final revised source: 363 library tests passed; 106 tests passed across constitution_claims, contract_conformance, core_tests, entrypoint_correctness, spec_conformance, substrate_integrity, workspace_interlock, and workspace_resolution. Eight pre-existing integration tests were ignored; no test failed.

Fresh independent review confirms only mountinfo parsing, explicit manual snapshot launcher, their tests and required authored/generated artifacts differ from master. Original filesystem denylist and intentional shared routes remain unchanged.

Latest design direction preserves shared database topology. Removed the proposed automatic-run restriction, Dactyl preflight expansion, and new blanket virtiofs/FUSE denylist additions. Existing master storage restrictions and actual I/O failures remain unchanged.

Snapshot regression coverage includes repeated launches, backup failure, runtime failure, TERM143 cleanup, shell-quoted paths, and mount syntax rejection. Mountinfo tests preserve the existing filesystem denylist and validate escaped and nested paths.
The supported workspace ensure --container command reports no Docker/Podman runtime. Source and shell mock checks do not prove actual VM mounts.

Validated source tree 421de50002082997079d26d8fd1512ab9638fc50 against source commit 232cfd7f6f1d60edb265ebcf63ed71cda989288e: 203 checks passed, 11 skipped, zero failures. Runtime and test source bytes are identical to the reviewed 363-library/106-integration test candidate. The clean-tree validation does not establish actual container execution.
